stem.text: A uniform beam is pivoted at P as shown. Weights of $10\,\text{N}$ and $20\,\text{N}$ are attached to its ends.
The length of the beam is marked at $0.1\,\text{m}$ intervals. The weight of the beam is $100\,\text{N}$.
At which point should a further weight of $20\,\text{N}$ be attached to achieve equilibrium?

stem.alt: Uniform beam pivoted at P, marked at 0.1 m intervals, with a 10 N weight at the left end and a 20 N weight at the right end; dimensions 0.6 m and 0.4 m are shown; points A, B, C and D are labelled along the beam.
